title: 22 November 1967: Tape copying: Sgt Pepper's Lonely Hearts Club Band, Sgt Pepper's Lonely Hearts Club Band (Reprise), Nowhere Man
content:
Studio Two (control room), EMI Studios, Abbey Road
Engineer: Geoff Emerick

During this brief session, which ran from 2.30-3.30pm, balance engineer Geoff Emerick made tape copies of three songs for the Yellow Submarine soundtrack.

The songs were ‘Sgt Pepper’s Lonely Hearts Club Band’, ‘Sgt Pepper’s Lonely Hearts Club Band (Reprise)’ and ‘Nowhere Man’. More copies of songs were made on the following day.

Page last updated: 10 December 2011

  • 1989: Paul McCartney interviewed in New York City

  • 1973: Mixing: Wide Prairie, I Got Up by Linda McCartney
  • 1972: Mixing: Winter Song, Shiranakatta (I Didn’t Know), Have You Seen A Horizon Lately? by Yoko Ono
  • 1972: Recording: Captain Of Love by Wings
  • 1971: John Lennon and Yoko Ono watch preview of Raga
  • 1968: UK album release: The Beatles (White Album)
  • 1966: John Lennon meets Yoko Ono for the second time
  • 1963: The Beatles live: Globe Cinema, Stockton-on-Tees
  • 1963: UK album release: With The Beatles
  • 1962: The Beatles live: Majestic Ballroom, Birkenhead
  • 1961: The Beatles live: Cavern Club, Liverpool (evening)
  • 1960: The Beatles live: Kaiserkeller, Hamburg – without George Harrison
